text_en: The word that Isaiah son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
text_cn: 阿摩兹的儿子依撒意亚关于犹大和耶路撒冷所见的事情：

text_en: In days to come the mountain of the Lord ’s house shall be established as the highest of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; all the nations shall stream to it.
text_cn: 到末日，上主的圣殿山必要矗立在群山之上，超乎一切山岳，万民都要向它涌来。

text_en: Many peoples shall come and say, “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the house of the God of Jacob; that he may teach us his ways and that we may walk in his paths. ” For out of Zion shall go forth instruction, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
text_cn: 将有许多民族前去，说：“来！我们攀登上主的圣山，往雅各伯天主的殿里去！他必指示我们他的道路，教给我们循行他的途径。因为法律将出自熙雍，上主的话将出自耶路撒冷。”

text_en: He shall judge between the nations, and shall arbitrate for many peoples; they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks; nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
text_cn: 他将统治万邦，治理众民；致使众人都把自己的刀剑铸成锄头，将自己的枪矛制成镰刀；民族与民族不再持刀相向，人也不再学习战斗。

text_en: O house of Jacob, come, let us walk in the light of the Lord !
text_cn: 雅各伯家！来让我们在上主的光明中行走吧！

text_en: For you have forsaken the ways of your people, O house of Jacob. Indeed they are full of diviners from the east and of soothsayers like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with foreigners.
text_cn: 是的！上主抛弃了自己的百姓──雅各伯家族──因为他们充满了术士和占卜者，有如培肋舍特人一样，且与异民握手言欢。

text_en: Their land is filled with silver and gold, and there is no end to their treasures; their land is filled with horses, and there is no end to their chariots.
text_cn: 他们的地域充满了金银，财宝不可估计；他们的地域充满了马匹，战车不可胜数。

text_en: Their land is filled with idols; they bow down to the work of their hands, to what their own fingers have made.
text_cn: 遍地都是偶像，人人崇拜自己手做的东西，崇拜自己手指的造像。

text_en: And so people are humbled, and everyone is brought low— do not forgive them!
text_cn: 如此，人自甘卑下，自甘堕落，对他们决无救援。

text_en: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust from the terror of the Lord , and from the glory of his majesty.
text_cn: 当上主起来震撼大地时，你要潜入岩穴，躲在土中，为逃避上主的威吓和他显赫的光辉。

text_en: The haughty eyes of people shall be brought low, and the pride of everyone shall be humbled; and the Lord alone will be exalted on that day.
text_cn: 目空一切的人必被抑制，性情高傲的人必被屈服：那一日，唯有上主受尊崇。

text_en: For the Lord of hosts has a day against all that is proud and lofty, against all that is lifted up and high;
text_cn: 因为万军的上主必有一日，要攻击所有骄矜自夸和自高自大的人，并加以抑制；

text_en: against all the cedars of Lebanon, lofty and lifted up; and against all the oaks of Bashan;
text_cn: 必要攻击黎巴嫩的一切高大香柏树和巴商的一切樟树；

text_en: against all the high mountains, and against all the lofty hills;
text_cn: 必要攻击一切高山和耸峙的山岭，

text_en: against every high tower, and against every fortified wall;
text_cn: 一切高塔和一切坚固的城墙，

text_en: against all the ships of Tarshish, and against all the beautiful craft.
text_cn: 塔尔史士的一切船只和一切美观的画舫。

text_en: The haughtiness of people shall be humbled, and the pride of everyone shall be brought low; and the Lord alone will be exalted on that day.
text_cn: 人的傲慢必被屈服，人的骄矜必被抑制：那一日，唯有上主受尊崇。

text_en: The idols shall utterly pass away.
text_cn: 上主必要完全毁灭偶像。

text_en: Enter the caves of the rocks and the holes of the ground, from the terror of the Lord , and from the glory of his majesty, when he rises to terrify the earth.
text_cn: 当上主起来震撼大地时，你们应潜入岩洞，躲在土穴中，为逃避上主的威吓和他显赫的光辉。

text_en: On that day people will throw away to the moles and to the bats their idols of silver and their idols of gold, which they made for themselves to worship,
text_cn: 那一日，人必将为自己制造来崇拜的银像和金像，抛给鼹(yǎn)鼠和蝙蝠，

text_en: to enter the caverns of the rocks and the clefts in the crags, from the terror of the Lord , and from the glory of his majesty, when he rises to terrify the earth.
text_cn: 以便在上主起来震撼大地的时候，逃避上主的威吓和他显赫的光辉，而隐藏在磐石的孔洞里和岩石的隙缝中。

text_en: Turn away from mortals, who have only breath in their nostrils, for of what account are they?
text_cn: 你们不要依恃人，因为他只有一口气在鼻孔里，他可算得什么？
